methodology.build_identity_limit: Artifact/source equivalence checks, not independent historical build attestation.
methodology.schedule: Full, sources-only, then diversity, once each. Serial paired variants reverse order each round; iteration 0 is excluded warmup.
methodology.timer: Local request/notification preparation through the complete correlated LSP response, including IO and sampler overhead; exact-result checks and cleanup outside successful latency.
methodology.initialization: One separate observation per project/variant/session, not a startup benchmark.
limits: No p95, statistical-significance, throughput, GUI, Mac, cold-cache or complete Java-conformance claim.
Sources-only removes platform/classpath semantics and is a separate control.
RSS is a non-atomic sampled native process-group sum; shared pages double-count and short peaks/processes may be missed.
Phase blocks are not interleaved LSP samples and their medians are not additive LSP latency.
